profit_pricing.title: Profit & Pricing Summary
profit_pricing.overheadDesc: Additional costs not directly tied to production.
profit_pricing.generalContingencyDesc: Flat percentage of direct costs for unforeseen expenses. Independent from risk contingency.
profit_pricing.contingencyBasisFlatDesc: Calculated as a flat percentage of direct costs.
profit_pricing.contingencyBasisRiskRegisterDesc: Direct sum of expected contingency amounts from the Risk tab.
profit_pricing.contingencyBasisCombinedDesc: Includes both the flat percentage and the risk register sum.
profit_pricing.generalContingencyIgnored: Ignored when using Risk Register as contingency basis.
profit_pricing.riskContingencyIncluded: Included in prime cost, bid price, and final total above.
profit_pricing.riskContingencyNotIncluded: Informational only — not included in totals above (change Contingency Basis to include).
profit_pricing.riskContingencyInfo: Probability-weighted total from your risk register (Σ impact × weight). Not included in the total above — it is additive with General Contingency, not interchangeable with it.
profit_pricing.riskContingencyCombinedTooltip: General Contingency (a flat % of direct costs) and Risk Contingency (probability-weighted from identified risks) are additive: they cover different unknowns. Do not merge one into the other; both contribute to total risk coverage.
profit_pricing.markupDesc: Profit margin added to the project cost.

tooltips.overhead: Overhead is calculated as a percentage of the total direct costs.
tooltips.generalContingency: General Contingency is a flat percentage of direct costs to cover unexpected expenses. It is additive with Risk Contingency, not interchangeable.
tooltips.markup: Markup is applied as a percentage of the Prime Cost (Direct Costs + Overhead + Contingency) to determine the profit margin.
tooltips.subtotal: The subtotal before tax is the sum of the Prime Cost and the Markup.
tooltips.tax: Taxes are applied as a percentage of the Subtotal (Before Tax).
tooltips.grandTotal: The Grand Total is the final price including all direct costs, overhead, contingency, markup, and taxes.

profit_pricing.generalContingencyError: General contingency percentage must be non-negative
profit_pricing.locationFactorError: Location factor must be at least 0.01
profit_pricing.defaultAssumptionsWarning: This estimate uses default financial assumptions; the percentages were never reviewed or saved. Open the Pricing tab to confirm them before sharing or exporting.
profit_pricing.locationFactorDesc: Cost multiplier for the project location (e.g. 1.15 = +15%). Applied to materials, labor, and equipment before overhead and markup.
profit_pricing.locationFactorTooltip: Multiplies direct costs (materials, labor, equipment) by a location-specific factor. Additional costs are not affected.
